t.zh: 质检台切到反相显示。原来亮的地方应当变暗，暗的地方应当变亮，位置不动。 <wiki-ref to="pointwise-transform"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The station switches to a negative display. Bright and dark readings trade places while locations stay fixed. <wiki-ref to="pointwise-transform"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 让 0 变成 1，1 变成 0，中间读数等距反过来。
brief.en: Map 0 to 1 and 1 to 0, reversing the readings in between at equal spacing.

naiveWhy.zh: 从读数里减去白点会产生负数，且保留亮暗的原有顺序。
naiveWhy.en: Subtracting white from the reading produces negative values and preserves the original brightness order.

hint.zh: 先想 0.25 和 0.75 距离白点各有多远。
hint.en: Compare how far 0.25 and 0.75 lie from white.

after.zh: 逐格变换可以反转亮暗关系，同时保留所有格子的位置。 <wiki-ref to="pointwise-transform"></wiki-ref>
after.en: A pointwise transform can reverse brightness while preserving cell locations. <wiki-ref to="pointwise-transform"></wiki-ref>
